author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The danger of having the same LLM read the spec, write the implementation plan, testplan and formal plan within the same context window in the same session.

The LLM mis-interpreted a line in the spec, but the RTL, the TB and the assertions all agree with each other, so everything passed, yet the design is wrong.

author.name: Artemios Diakogiannis
author.headline: Lead Principal Verification Engineer - Verification Domain TL at Infineon Technologies
